source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed the eight crosscutting technical-management process sections, Phase E systems engineering, and NPR 7123.1B. NASA lifecycle terminology and governance are explicit and presented as a coherent authoritative example requiring tailoring rather than a universal organizational prescription.

evidence: Reviewed evolution system E=(configurations, transitions, integrity obligations, evidence, authorities/effectivity).
Reviewed path admissibility requiring evidence or accepted bounded exception for each obligation applicable to every state.
Reviewed configuration and transition tuples and distinction between authorized and observed state by time/instance.
Reviewed transition-debt and integrity-debt sets without collapsing noncompensable obligations into a single score.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently treats current, intermediate, target, fallback, actual, and retired states as distinct configuration- and authority-bound objects.

evidence: Executed evolution-integrity-path-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-090/report.json.
Confirmed three states and four obligations create twelve required state-obligation pairs.
Confirmed eleven initial evidenced pairs and coexistence:data_integrity as the sole missing pair.
Confirmed correction yields twelve declared evidenced pairs, zero missing, and only metadata-gate eligibility.
Recomputed Exercise 2 direct evidence coverage as 21/24=87.5 percent and evidence-or-exception coverage as 23/24 approximately 95.83 percent.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Boolean coverage does not validate obligation/state completeness, evidence quality, accepted-exception legitimacy, behavior, effectivity, observation, interaction, or promotion authority.

evidence: Confirmed system integrity does not entail immobility; unsupported stasis and uncontrolled change can each degrade integrity.
Confirmed target-state integrity does not entail safe or authorized intermediate states.
Confirmed syntactic backward compatibility does not entail semantic, data, timing, security/privacy, operational, or resource compatibility.
Confirmed unchanged artifacts do not entail evidence continuity when environment, dependencies, tools, data, interfaces, suppliers, or use change.
Confirmed target traffic or deployment does not entail complete effectivity, recovery, support, or superseded-state retirement.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Implication limits prevent roadmap, interface, change-size, evidence-reuse, canary, automation, and deployment signals from becoming false integrity proof.

evidence: Challenged idealized current baselines, hidden drift/workarounds/emergency changes, unsupported dependencies, incomplete roadmaps, distributed authority, long-lead option loss, and imposed dates without evidence readiness.

Challenged mixed hardware/software/schema/site/customer states, adapters, dual writes, flags, temporary permissions, degraded modes, rollback, recovery, offline fleets, spares/repairs, and disaster environments.

Challenged semantic/interface/data migration, late/in-flight data, resource margins, control-and-monitoring simultaneous change, common-cause/cumulative releases, supplier lots, skills/test capacity, and unrepresentative canaries.

Challenged irreversible physical/data/credential/contract changes, weak observation, automatic remediation evidence loss, repeated exception extensions, transition debt normalization, and old state re-entry through support or recovery.
Reviewed all ten examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limitations, uncertainty, effectivity, exception authority, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Real evolution decisions require applicable systems/domain, architecture, configuration, software/data/platform, interface, supplier/manufacturing, human/operations/support, safety/security/privacy, V&V, finance/contracts/records, and technical-authority expertise.

evidence: Confirmed integrity obligations name claim, threshold, context, owner, method, configuration, evidence and effectivity.

Confirmed planning begins from observed/current state and links capability, requirements, architecture, interface, technology, obsolescence, data, evidence, workforce, funding, deployment, support and retirement.
Confirmed every transition state has exact configuration, compatibility, data, identity/policy, procedures/support, monitoring, authority, entry/exit, recovery and duration.
Confirmed individual/cumulative impact, common cause, resources, uncertainty, noncompensable constraints, representative prototyping and claim-level evidence continuity precede promotion.
Confirmed actual-state/fleet observations account for pending, offline, failed, rollback, exemption, unknown, spares/repairs and recovery populations.
Confirmed closure verifies target outcomes and removes superseded products/services/data/access/stock/tools/contracts, bridges, flags, waivers and residual transition obligations.
invariant_checking.notes: No roadmap date, target design, ticket approval, compatibility label, unchanged-file ratio, canary, dashboard, automation declaration, rollback promise, or target traffic percentage is treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: No formal proof or theorem requires proof review; state-path admissibility is a bounded governance model.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled declared_boolean_coverage_only.

Fixture limitations disclaim obligation/state completeness, evidence quality, authority, semantics, behavior, actual configuration, effectivity, interactions, uncertainty, exceptions, recovery, monitoring, and promotion.

Examples and exercises are synthetic teaching cases, not actual evolution roadmaps, architecture approvals, safety/security decisions, migration authorizations, supplier qualifications, or operational promotions.
Official sources are attributed without claiming NASA review, approval, or endorsement of this chapter.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic coverage, source-backed guidance, internal review, configured evidence gates, technical authority, and observed operational integrity remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked integrity definitions, observed baseline, change framing, linked multi-horizon roadmaps, architectural runway, transition states/invariants, interface/data/security evolution, evidence continuity, cumulative portfolios, uncertainty, prototypes/gates, operations, actual-state accounting, recovery, debt, closure, and replanning.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked hardware/software/data/platform and supplier evolution, mixed fleets/sites/customers, schemas/APIs, identity/policy, canaries/cohorts, adapters/dual writes/flags, emergency paths, support/spares/repair, monitoring, rollback/forward recovery, portfolio capacity, old-stack removal, and residual obligations.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from integrity obligations and current state through roadmaps, transitions, impact/evidence, staged operation, closure, and learning. Ten examples and five complete solutions cover fleet controllers, dual writes, independent monitoring, cumulative margin, suppliers, emergencies, managed services, canary exposure, adapter debt, and recovery closure.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA expert, systems/domain engineer, architect/interface/configuration authority, supplier/manufacturer, software/data/platform owner, operator/maintainer, human-factors specialist, safety/security/privacy authority, V&V/certification authority, finance/contracts/records authority, customer/regulator, auditor, or other external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
